whatIsIt.eli5: Decides which groups exist for this picture and how much each pixel belongs to each group.
whatIsIt.simple: Builds hyperedge prototypes from learned base vectors plus offsets computed from the whole image (mean and max), then scores every pixel against every prototype (multi-head) and softmaxes over pixels.
whatIsIt.engineer: protos = P_base + Lin([mean(X)‖max(X)]); logits = mean_h((X W_h)(protos_h)ᵀ/√d_h); A = softmax_N(dropout(logits)).

whyExists.simple: Hyperedges adapt to the content instead of being fixed.
